name: mplus-stats-coach
description: An Mplus learning agent that explains syntax, reviews .inp code, interprets output, advises on model choice, and diagnoses warnings and errors, with every claim traceable to a source.

displayDescription.zh: 面向心理学与教育学研究者，讲透 Mplus 语法与潜变量建模，诊断报错，解读结果，规范论文方法与结果写作，全程可溯源。
displayDescription.en: An Mplus learning agent for psychology and education researchers: syntax explained, .inp reviewed, output interpreted, warnings diagnosed, and methods sections written to a traceable standard.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我检查这段 Mplus 语法，指出哪里写错了，并解释原因。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this Mplus syntax, point out what is wrong, and explain why.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检查这段 Mplus 语法，指出哪里写错了，并解释原因。
quickPrompts.en: Review this Mplus syntax, point out what is wrong, and explain why.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要做潜剖面分析，给我一份可直接运行的 Mplus 示例语法。
quickPrompts.en: I want to run a latent profile analysis. Give me a runnable Mplus example.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份 Mplus 输出结果怎么读？拟合指标达标吗？论文里该怎么写？
quickPrompts.en: How do I read this Mplus output? Are the fit indices acceptable? How should I write it up?
